title: Largest Rectangle in Histogram
description: Given an array of integers `heights` representing the histogram's bar height where the width of each bar is 1, return the area of the largest rectangle in the histogram.
input_format: First line contains integer `n`, followed by `n` bar heights.

sample_tests.explanation: The largest rectangle has height 5 and width 2: area = 10.

hints: Maintain a monotonic increasing stack of bar indices.
When height decreases, the bar at the top of the stack cannot extend further right.
Calculate rectangle area using popped height and width `(i - stk[-1] - 1)`.

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n = int(data[0])
    h = [int(x) for x in data[1:1+n]] + [0]
    stk = []
    max_area = 0
    for i in range(len(h)):
        while stk and h[stk[-1]] > h[i]:
            height = h[stk.pop()]
            width = i if not stk else (i - stk[-1] - 1)
            max_area = max(max_area, height * width)
        stk.append(i)
    print(max_area)
